            <h1>Azure Alerts Management</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure Alerts Management</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (2)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure Alerts Management supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

        });

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {

                }

                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Azure App Configuration</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure App Configuration</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure App Configuration supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/azure-app-configuration/components/configuration-store/icons/color/configuration-store-color.svg"
                        alt="configuration-store"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/azure-app-configuration/components/configuration-store/icons/white/configuration-store-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/azure-app-configuration/components/configuration-store/icons/color/configuration-store-color.svg" />

            </div>
            
            
        </section>
    </div>
    

    
    
    

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Azure App Service</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure App Service</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (4)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure App Service supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/azure-architecture\/icons\/color\/azure-architecture-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

            <h1>Azure Authorization</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure Authorization</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (2)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure Authorization supports the following components.</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Azure Batch</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure Batch</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure Batch supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/azure-cdn\/icons\/color\/azure-cdn-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Azure Container Instance</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure Container Instance</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure Container Instance supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    function handleImageError(image) {

        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/azure-container-instance\/icons\/color\/azure-container-instance-color.svg';

    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";

<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure Container Registry</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Azure Container Service</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure Container Service</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (7)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure Container Service supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">
                    <img class="logo-dark-light"
                        src="/content/en/extensions/models/azure-container-service/components/fleet/icons/color/fleet-color.svg"
                        alt="fleet"
                        onerror="handleImageError(this)"
                        data-logo-for-dark="/content/en/extensions/models/azure-container-service/components/fleet/icons/white/fleet-white.svg"
                        data-logo-for-light="/content/en/extensions/models/azure-container-service/components/fleet/icons/color/fleet-color.svg" />

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Azure Data Factory</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure Data Factory</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure Data Factory supports the following components.</p>
            
        </section>

        <section class="componentsSection">
            
            
            <div class="maincontainer">
                <div class="componentimg">

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Azure DB for PostgreSQL</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure DB for PostgreSQL</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (8)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure DB for PostgreSQL supports the following components.</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/azure-db-for-postgresql\/icons\/color\/azure-db-for-postgresql-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

            <h1>Azure Devices</h1>
          
          
<article>
    <p>Collaborative and visual infrastructure as design for Azure Devices</p>
    
    
    <div>
        <section class="Compheading">
            
            <h3>
                Components (1)
            </h3>
            <p>The Meshery model for Azure Devices supports the following components.</p>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/azure-devices\/icons\/color\/azure-devices-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/azure-documentdb\/icons\/color\/azure-documentdb-color.svg';

    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    function handleImageError(image) {
        image.onerror = null;
        image.src = '\/extensions\/models\/azure-entra\/icons\/color\/azure-entra-color.svg';
    }
    const designLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.design-link');
    if (designLinks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('related-designs-header').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const relatedTutorials = document.querySelectorAll(".tutorial-link");
    if (relatedTutorials.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("related-tutorials-header").style.display = "none";
    }

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>
